title: Parsing gigabytes of JSON per second
relevance: Introduced the bit-parallel structural indexing approach using CLMUL for prefix-XOR operations. This concept refines and tightens the cascade into minimal instruction count.

title: Mison: A Fast JSON Parser for Data Analytics
relevance: First to propose converting JSON parsing control flow into data flow via bitwise structural indices. The cascade concept builds on Mison's foundational insight.

title: Parsing JSON faster with Intel AVX-512
relevance: Discusses how wider AVX-512 registers (512 bits = 64 bytes) naturally align with the 64-byte bitmap cascade, processing one full bitmap per SIMD iteration.
